record.description:
SHIFT LEADER (m/f/d)
BUYA & REI · Berlin-Kreuzberg

Japanese soul. Kreuzberg energy. Your next move.

Homemade ramen at BUYA. Japanese sharing plates, cocktails and sake at REI. Two spots with their own personality, right in the heart of Kreuzberg — and we’re looking for a Shift Leader who can keep service running smoothly and make people feel welcome.

Tasks

Your shift. Your team.

You’ll lead the floor, support your crew and keep an eye on the details. From the first briefing to the final handover, you’ll coordinate service, stay connected with the kitchen and bar, and handle guest requests with confidence. When things get busy, you bring calm, clear decisions and a hands-on attitude.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Experience in restaurant service and in leading shifts or a team.
  • A warm presence with guests and clear communication with colleagues.
  • Good judgement, reliability and an eye for what needs doing.
  • A love for food, drinks and thoughtful hospitality.
  • Availability for evenings and weekends.

Sound like your kind of place?

Send us your CV, your availability and a few lines about yourself.

Let’s make Kreuzberg nights worth coming back for.

record.description:
What you can expect from us

At Eraneos Germany, we partner with organizations to master complex challenges and shape a sustainable, digital future. As a (Senior) Consultant in our Production & Operations team, you will support leading organizations in navigating change and unlocking performance improvements. Working in multidisciplinary project teams, you will contribute to strategic and operational transformation initiatives, develop valuable industry expertise, and help clients translate ambitious goals into tangible business results.

Your Responsibilities

  • Support transformation and operational improvement projects across manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering environments
  • Analyze business processes and operational performance to identify improvement opportunities and support decision-making
  • Contribute to the design of target operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
  • Support operational strategy and optimization initiatives across manufacturing, supply chain, and operations
  • Apply lean and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and business outcomes
  • Develop client deliverables and support workshops, stakeholder engagement, and project execution activities


Who you are

Are you an analytical thinker with strong social skills, are curious and enjoy working as a team player? In addition to a high degree of personal initiative and an entrepreneurial can-do mentality, you possess the following distinguishing qualities:

  • 2+ years of experience in management consulting, delivering transformation and operational improvement projects across manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering environments
  • University degree in engineering, business administration, economics, or a comparable field
  • Understanding of operational processes,continuous improvement methodologies and transformation initiatives in industrial environments
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage effectively with different stakeholders
  • Fluent German and English language skills
  • Flexibility and willingness to travel based on client and project needs


Who we are

Eraneos is an international consulting group specializing in strategy, transformation, and technology that helps companies succeed in a dynamic digital world. With world-class experts in business and technology, we empower our clients to set new standards for sustainable transformation – from strategy to implementation. Whether designing future-proof organizations, unlocking new potential through data and AI, or safeguarding companies with comprehensive cybersecurity, we deliver results in a pragmatic and goal-oriented manner.

Our team of approximately 1,300 dedicated employees is based in offices across Germany, Switzerland, The Netherlands, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, The United Kingdom, Singapore, Japan and The United States and combines global perspectives with strong local roots.

In addition to challenging projects in a multinational environment, we are characterized by a high degree of entrepreneurial freedom and continuous growth. At our company, we take pride in our strong sense of community, based on mutual appreciation and support. We offer excellent promotion opportunities as well as individual career development mentoring. Our employees are seen as the heart of the company, which is why we provide above-average compensation as well as numerous additional benefits.


Contact

Patricia Herbst - 
Our top priority is that you fit us and we fit you, regardless of origin, nationality, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity, age, handicap or other aspects of diversity.

Our dedicated HR Team will be happy to provide you with further information and is looking forward to receiving your CV and / or your complete and expressive Linked in / Xing profile.
